skill.name: product-photography
skill.description: Create AI product images with practical guidance for studio packshots, lifestyle scenes, camera angles, lighting, backgrounds, composition, and e-commerce image sets.
skill.summary: Plan and generate consistent product photography for listings and campaigns.
skill.author: 101-skills

security_audit.summary: Review confirmed two medium supply-chain risks from unpinned npx skill installations. The remaining 32 static findings are Markdown fences, literal belt examples, inline command names, or documentation URLs without shell interpolation. Separate semantic review found external image transmission and broad belt wildcard permission; no prompt injection or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: The skill recommends installing third-party skills without version or commit pins.
remediation.suggestion: Pin every npx skill source to a reviewed immutable version or commit, and document a verification process before installation.

remediation.issue: Remote inference workflows can transmit product prompts and local product images.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the receiving service, data retention terms, and image-upload behavior before users run generation, editing, or upscaling commands.

remediation.issue: The Bash permission permits every belt subcommand.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict allowed tools to required belt subcommands where supported, or require user confirmation before commands that upload data.

semantic_findings.title: External Product Data Transmission
semantic_findings.description: The workflow submits prompts to remote inference applications and can upload local product images during editing or upscaling. This may expose unreleased products or image metadata to an external service.

content.value_statement: Product teams need consistent images for listings and campaigns. This skill provides practical prompts, shot guidance, and remote generation workflows for polished product photography.
actual_capabilities: Creates prompt specifications for hero shots, white-background packshots, lifestyle scenes, scale references, details, and collection images.
Recommends camera angles, lighting setups, shadow styles, backgrounds, and composition rules for different products.
Plans complete seven-to-nine-image e-commerce listing sets with a clear purpose for each image.
Tailors visual direction for food, jewelry, electronics, cosmetics, and apparel.
Provides belt CLI examples for remote image generation, editing, and upscaling.
Documents common image problems and practical corrections for more consistent results.
limitations: Requires the belt CLI, an authenticated account, network access, and available remote inference applications.
Generated images may alter product geometry, labels, materials, colors, or fine details.
Marketplace requirements can change, so users must verify current platform policies before publishing.
Editing and upscaling workflows may upload local product images to an external inference service.

use_cases.title: Build a Marketplace Listing Set
use_cases.description: Plan a consistent sequence of packshot, lifestyle, scale, detail, alternate-angle, and packaging images for one product.

use_cases.title: Direct a Lifestyle Campaign
use_cases.description: Define lighting, props, composition, and brand backgrounds for a coordinated product campaign.

use_cases.title: Improve Seller Photography
use_cases.description: Create compliant primary images and supporting visuals that communicate size, materials, features, and use.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Packshot
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a clean packshot specification for [product] on a pure white background. Include angle, lighting, shadow, framing, and resolution.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when preparing a primary e-commerce listing image.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Complete Listing
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan seven images for [product] on [marketplace]. Describe each shot, its purpose, composition, lighting, background, and important compliance checks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when building a complete product detail page.

prompt_templates.title: Develop a Brand Image System
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a consistent visual direction for [product line]. Define repeatable angles, lighting, shadows, backgrounds, props, color treatment, and negative space.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when several products need one recognizable style.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Editing Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a belt workflow for [source image]. Generate a lifestyle background, preserve product details, upscale the result, and list review checkpoints.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when adapting an approved product image for campaign use.

output_examples.input: Create a primary listing image for a black wireless speaker.
output: Shot: Three-quarter packshot with the speaker centered and filling about 85 percent of the frame.
Lighting: Soft, even studio light with a subtle contact shadow.
Background: Pure white with no props, text, badges, or watermarks.
Review: Confirm grille geometry, controls, logo placement, color, and current marketplace requirements.

output_examples.input: Plan lifestyle photography for a premium ceramic coffee mug.
output: Scene: Mug on a simple breakfast table beside one book and a folded linen napkin.
Lighting: Warm natural window light with soft directional shadows.
Composition: Place the mug near a rule-of-thirds intersection and preserve space for campaign copy.
Review: Check handle shape, glaze color, scale, rim geometry, and surface artifacts.

output_examples.input: Create a seven-image listing plan for a leather wallet.
output_examples.output: The plan includes a white-background hero, lifestyle use, card-capacity feature, hand scale, leather detail, alternate angle, and packaging image.

best_practices: Provide exact product attributes and review every generation against approved reference images.
Keep lighting, background families, camera angles, and color treatment consistent across a listing set.
Verify image dimensions, backgrounds, overlays, and file formats against current marketplace requirements.
anti_patterns: Do not publish generated labels, logos, dimensions, or materials without checking them against the real product.
Do not crowd lifestyle scenes with props that obscure the product or confuse its intended use.
Do not upload confidential product images or metadata before reviewing the external service terms.

faq.question: Does this skill generate images locally?
faq.answer: No. Its examples use the belt CLI to call remote inference applications.

faq.question: Can it create Amazon primary images?
faq.answer: It provides white-background packshot guidance, but users must verify current Amazon category and image policies.

faq.question: Can it preserve an exact product design?
faq.answer: No model can guarantee exact fidelity. Compare outputs with approved references and correct any changed details.

faq.question: Which product categories are covered?
faq.answer: The guide includes food, jewelry, electronics, cosmetics, apparel, and general e-commerce products.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing product image?
faq.answer: Yes. The guide includes remote background editing and upscaling workflows using supported belt applications.

faq.question: What information should a request include?
faq.answer: Include product type, exact attributes, target channel, shot purpose, background, lighting, angle, aspect ratio, and brand constraints.
